message: Contemporaneous only: lag0 r=0.25 (perm p=0.03, Bonferroni 0.71); lead lags weak (lag+1 r=0.03). Rule z>1 long TTF 1d: 51 trades, hit 47pct, excess -0.15pct/trade; OOS war 15 trades +1.5pct avg. Actionability 3.3, validity 0 - not tradeable as a lead signal.
